latest_release.name: v2.0.8
latest_release.body: In YASB 2.0.8, the **Notifications widget** now shows your notifications in a menu grouped by app instead of just a count. You can click one to open the app, clear them per app, and see sender photos and toast images. The **Window Switcher** gained an **Alt+Tab style keybind** with optional live thumbnail previews, and the **Windows Desktops** widget can switch desktops with the mouse wheel and highlights desktops that have open windows. We also fixed several crashes and freezes: the **Taskbar** no longer crashes when grouped windows close quickly, **Quick Launch** no longer freezes on startup or rebuilds constantly, and the **Volume** widget keeps updating its value. Tray icon order and pins now survive a restart, and the **GPU** widget reports utilization the same way Task Manager does.
